The 98th Academy Awards took over the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles on Sunday night, as Hollywood’s biggest names gathered to celebrate the top films and performances of the past year.Hosted for the second year in a row by Brookline native, comedian Conan O’Brien, the ceremony opened with O’Brien dashing through scenes from nominated films dressed as Aunt Gladys, and forced to go onstage as Amy Madigan’s “Weapons” character, complete with red wig and white makeup.To continue reading, please login or subscribe to Globe.comGet 6 Months of Unlimited Access for $1Get 6 Months of Unlimited Access for $1Watch MoreGet Starting PointA guide through the most important stories of the morning, delivered Monday through Friday.Enter EmailSara Murphy, left, winner of the award for best picture for "One Battle After Another," and Paul Thomas Anderson, winner of the awards for writing (adapted screenplay), directing, and best picture for "One Battle After Another," pose in the press room at the Oscars on Sunday at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles.Jordan Strauss/Jordan Strauss/Invision/APBest pictureBest actressBest actorBest directorBest original songJoachim Trier accepts the award for international feature film for "Sentimental Value" during the Oscars on Sunday, at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles.
